1. Front country RX Data pre-processing
Fuels
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load fuels data frames
fuels25sp <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Spring25RX_fuels_report.csv") %>%
pivot_longer(cols=4:16, names_to="FuelCategory", values_to="value") %>%
filter(FuelCategory %in% c("OneHr","TenHr","HunHr","FineWood","ThoHr_Snd","ThoHr_Rot","TotalWood","Duff","Litter","TotalAll")) %>% mutate(Burn = "HQ_Spring25")

fuels24f <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Fall24RX_fuels_report.csv") %>%
pivot_longer(cols=4:16, names_to="FuelCategory", values_to="value") %>%
filter(FuelCategory %in% c("OneHr","TenHr","HunHr","FineWood","ThoHr_Snd","ThoHr_Rot","TotalWood","Duff","Litter","TotalAll")) %>% mutate(Burn = "HQ_Fall24")

fuels25f <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Fall25RX_fuels_report.csv") %>% 
  add_row(Plot = "PIPO_09", MonStatus = "02POST", OneHr = 0.06693385, TenHr = 1.4481455, HunHr = 0.9973587, FineWood = 2.5124380, ThoHr_Snd = 0, ThoHr_Rot = 0, TotalWood = 2.5124380, Duff = 4.142737, Litter = 3.843262, TotalAll = 10.498438, DuffDep = 0.415, LittDep = 0.77, TotDep = 1.185 )%>% 
  add_row(Plot = "PIPO_27", MonStatus = "02POST", OneHr = 0.06984402, TenHr = .7101483, HunHr = 0.3324529, FineWood = 1.1124452, ThoHr_Snd = 0, ThoHr_Rot = 0, TotalWood = 1.1124452, Duff = 3.044662, Litter = 4.067869, TotalAll = 8.224976, DuffDep = 0.305, LittDep = 0.815, TotDep = 1.12 )%>% 
pivot_longer(cols=4:16, names_to="FuelCategory", values_to="value") %>% rename(Macroplot = Plot) %>%
filter(FuelCategory %in% c("OneHr","TenHr","HunHr","FineWood","ThoHr_Snd","ThoHr_Rot","TotalWood","Duff","Litter","TotalAll")) %>% 
  mutate(Burn = case_when(Macroplot %in% c("PIPO_09", "PIPO_27", "PIPS_14") ~ "HQ_Fall25", TRUE ~ "BM_Fall25"))

# Combine and format
fuels <- bind_rows(fuels24f, fuels25sp, fuels25f) %>% dplyr::select(-1)
fuels <- fuels %>% 
  mutate(FuelCategory=factor(FuelCategory,levels=c("OneHr","TenHr","HunHr","FineWood","ThoHr_Snd","ThoHr_Rot","TotalWood","Duff","Litter","TotalAll")))%>%
  mutate(MonStatus = case_when(MonStatus %in% c("00PRE","01PRE", "02PRE") ~ "PRE", MonStatus %in% c("03POST", "02POST", "01POST") ~ "POST", TRUE ~ "01YR01"))
fuels$MonStatus <- factor(fuels$MonStatus, levels = c("PRE", "POST", "01YR01"), ordered = TRUE)

fuels[is.na(fuels)] <- 0


write.csv(fuels, "Biennial/rx_fuels.csv")



```

```{r}
# Load Data & Combine
cover1 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Fall24RX_cover_data.csv") %>% dplyr::select(c(2,3, 7:12)) %>% mutate(Burn = "Fall24")
cover2 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Spring25RX_cover_data.csv") %>% dplyr::select(c(2,3,8:13)) %>% rename(Plot = MacroPlot.Name)%>% 
  mutate(Burn = "Spring25")

spcover <- cover %>% group_by(Plot, Status2) %>% mutate(hpp = n()) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(Plot, Status2, Species, Burn, FuncGroup, Native, SpeciesName) %>% summarise(HitsPerPlot = first(hpp), Hits = n(), PctCover=(n()/HitsPerPlot*100), .groups = "drop") 

fgcover <- cover %>% group_by(Plot, Status2) %>% mutate(hpp = n()) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(Plot, Status2,Burn, FuncGroup, Native) %>% 
  summarise(HitsPerPlot = first(hpp), FGHits = n(), FGPctCover=(n()/HitsPerPlot*100), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(cover, "Biennial2026/Data/rx_cover.csv")

shrub <- cover %>% filter(FuncGroup == "Shrub") %>% group_by(Plot, Status2, Burn, SpeciesName, Species) %>% summarise(hits = n(), PctCover = (n()/40)*100, .groups = "drop")

write.csv(shrub, "Biennial2026/Data/rx_shrub.csv")
```

Trees
```{r}
# Load data and combine
trees1 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Spring25RX_trees_data.csv") %>% rename(Plot = MacroPlot.Name) %>% mutate(Burn = "Spring25")
trees2 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Fall24RX_trees_data.csv") %>% mutate(Burn = "Fall24")
trees3 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Fall25RX_trees_data.csv") %>% mutate(Burn = "Fall25")
trees <- bind_rows(trees1, trees2, trees3)

# Format
trees <- trees %>% dplyr::select(2,3,6:15, 19:22) %>%mutate(TreeBA_ft2 = (pi*(DBH/200)^2)*10.7639, PlotArea_Acres = 0.079) 
trees <- trees %>% mutate(Status2 = case_when(Status2 == "00PRE" ~ "PreBurn", Status2 == "01YR01" ~ "1YrPostBurn", TRUE ~ Status2))
trees$Status2 <- factor(trees$Status2, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn", "1YrPostBurn"))


write.csv(trees, "Biennial2026/Data//rx_trees.csv")




```

1. Fuels 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# (1) Read in fuels data
fuels <- read.csv("Biennial2026/Data//rx_fuels.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-1)
fuels$MonStatus <- factor(fuels$MonStatus, levels = c("PRE", "POST", "01YR01"), ordered = TRUE)

# (2) Table showing fuel consumption
tbl <- fuels %>% filter(FuelCategory %in% c("FineWood", "Litter", "Duff", "TotalAll")) %>% filter(MonStatus %in% c("PRE", "POST")) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Macroplot, FuelCategory, Burn), names_from = MonStatus, values_from = value) %>% mutate(Change = POST - PRE, PctChange = round(((POST-PRE)/PRE)*100,1)) %>% group_by(FuelCategory,Burn) %>%summarise(MeanValue = round(mean(PctChange, na.rm=TRUE),1), .groups="drop") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = FuelCategory, values_from = MeanValue)%>% dplyr::select(Burn, FineWood, Litter, Duff, TotalAll) %>% rename(TotalSurfaceFuels = TotalAll, FineWoody = FineWood)
tbl$Burn <- factor(tbl$Burn, levels = c("HQ_Fall24", "HQ_Spring25", "HQ_Fall25", "BM_Fall25")) 
tbl <- tbl %>% arrange(Burn)

# GT TABLE with simple bold average row + divider
tbl_gt <- tbl %>% gt() %>% tab_header(title = "Percent Fuel Consumption by Fuel Type") 

tbl_gt

#*****TO DO: make table look nicer: bold headers, separate burns with a column or something

# (3) Plot Fuel Loads
fuelplot <- fuels %>% filter(FuelCategory %in% c("FineWood", "Litter", "Duff", "TotalAll")) %>% group_by(MonStatus, Burn, FuelCategory) %>% 
  summarise(mean = round(mean(value), 1), sd = round(sd(value), 1), .groups = "drop")
fuelplot$Burn <- factor(fuelplot$Burn, levels = c("HQ_Fall24", "HQ_Spring25", "BM_Fall25", "HQ_Fall25"))
fuelplot <- fuelplot %>% arrange(Burn)

ggplot(fuelplot, aes(x = FuelCategory, y = mean, fill = MonStatus)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9))+ geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean - sd,0), ymax = mean + sd),position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.2) + facet_wrap(~Burn)+ scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal)+ theme_nps() + labs(title="Effects of RX Burn on Surface Fuels", y="Avg. Fuel Load (tons/acre)", x = "Fuel Category", fill = "Monitoring Status") +theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))
  

# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

# (4) Stats

# Format data for stats: Log-transform, 
fuels2 <- fuels %>% filter(MonStatus %in% c("PRE", "POST")) %>% filter(FuelCategory %in% c("FineWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll")) %>% mutate(value = sqrt(value)) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Macroplot, MonStatus, Burn), names_from = FuelCategory, values_from = value)
fuels2 <- fuels2 %>% mutate(MonStatus = factor(MonStatus, levels = c("PRE", "POST")))
fuel_vars <- c("FineWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll")


#Pairwise comparisons between pre and post
pairwise_results <- map_dfr(fuel_vars, function(var) {
  m <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(var, " ~ MonStatus*Burn + (1|Macroplot)")), data = fuels2)
  em <- emmeans(m, pairwise ~ MonStatus | Burn, adjust = "BH")
  
  as.data.frame(em$contrasts) %>%
    mutate(FuelCategory = var) %>%
    dplyr::select(Burn, FuelCategory, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value)
})

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>% mutate(estimate = round(estimate, 2),SE = round(SE, 2),t.ratio = round(t.ratio, 2),p.value = round(p.value, 3))

# Tables
a <- pairwise_results%>% filter(Burn == "BM_Fall25") %>% dplyr::select(-c(contrast, Burn)) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "BM_Fall25 Fuel Loads Pre vs. Post Burn") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.05))

b <- pairwise_results%>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Fall25") %>% dplyr::select(-c(contrast, Burn)) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "HQ_Fall25 Fuel Loads Pre vs. Post Burn") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.05))

c <- pairwise_results%>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Spring25") %>% dplyr::select(-c(contrast, Burn)) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "HQ_Spring25 Fuel Loads Pre vs. Post Burn") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.05))

d <- pairwise_results%>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Fall24") %>% dplyr::select(-c(contrast, Burn)) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "HQ_Fall24 Fuel Loads Pre vs. Post Burn") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.05))

ggarrange(a, b, c, d, ncol = 1)

# Linear mixed effects model/PERMANOVA
fuels3 <- fuels %>% mutate(value = sqrt(value)) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Macroplot, MonStatus, Burn), names_from = FuelCategory, values_from = value)

#HQ Fall 24
fuels_mat <- fuels3 %>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Fall24")%>% dplyr::select(-c(1:3))
fuels_meta <- fuels3 %>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Fall24")%>% dplyr::select(1:2)
vegan::adonis2(fuels_mat ~ MonStatus, data = fuels_meta, strata = fuels_meta$Macroplot, method = "bray", permutations =999)
# p = 0.001

#HQ Spring25
fuels_mat <- fuels3 %>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Spring25")%>% dplyr::select(-c(1:3))
fuels_meta <- fuels3 %>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Spring25")%>% dplyr::select(1:2)
vegan::adonis2(fuels_mat ~ MonStatus, data = fuels_meta, strata = fuels_meta$Macroplot, method = "bray", permutations =999)
# p = 0.028

#HQ Fall25
fuels_mat <- fuels3 %>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Fall25")%>% dplyr::select(-c(1:3))
fuels_meta <- fuels3 %>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Fall25")%>% dplyr::select(1:2)
vegan::adonis2(fuels_mat ~ MonStatus, data = fuels_meta, strata = fuels_meta$Macroplot, method = "bray", permutations =999)
# p = 0.25

#BM Fall25
fuels_mat <- fuels3 %>% filter(Burn == "BM_Fall25")%>% dplyr::select(-c(1:3))
fuels_meta <- fuels3 %>% filter(Burn == "BM_Fall25")%>% dplyr::select(1:2)
vegan::adonis2(fuels_mat ~ MonStatus, data = fuels_meta, strata = fuels_meta$Macroplot, method = "bray", permutations =999)
# p = 0.25




```

2. Cover
```{r}

# Read in Cover Data
cover <- read.csv("Biennial2026/Data/rx_cover.csv")

# Plot of Functional Group Cover
fgcover <- cover %>% dplyr::select(Plot, Status2, Burn, FuncGroup, Native, HitsPerPlot, FGHits, FGPctCover)
fgcover <- unique(fgcover)
fgcover$Status2 <- factor(fgcover$Status2, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn"))
fgcover$FuncGroup <- as.factor(fgcover$FuncGroup)
fgcover <- fgcover %>% filter(FuncGroup %in% c("Forb", "Grass", "Shrub"))

ggplot(fgcover %>% dplyr::filter(Burn == "Fall24"), aes(x = FuncGroup, y = FGPctCover, fill = FuncGroup)) + geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) + facet_wrap(~Status2) + scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) + labs(title = "Understory Cover for Fall 2024 RX Burn", y = "Percent Cover", x = "Functional Group") + theme_nps() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1), legend.position = "none")

ggplot(fgcover %>% dplyr::filter(Burn == "Spring25"), aes(x = FuncGroup, y = FGPctCover, fill = FuncGroup)) + geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) + facet_wrap(~Status2) + scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) + labs(title = "Understory Cover for Spring 2025 RX Burn", y = "Percent Cover", x = "Functional Group") + theme_nps() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1), legend.position = "none")

# Plot of Non-Native Cover
native <- cover %>% filter(Native =="non-native")
native <- native %>% mutate(SpeciesName = case_when(Species == "VETH" ~ "Verbascum thapsus", Species == "BRINI" ~ "Bromus inermis",
                                                    Species == "LEDE" ~ "Lepidium densiflorum",Species == "LIDAD" ~ "Linaria dalmatica",
                                                    Species == "TAOF" ~ "Taraxacum officinale", TRUE ~ SpeciesName)) 
native$Status2 <- factor(native$Status2, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn"))

ggplot(native, aes(x = SpeciesName, y = PctCover, fill = FuncGroup))+ geom_col(aes(y = mean(PctCover)), alpha = 0.8) + facet_wrap(~Status2, scales = "free_x")+ scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) + labs(title = "Non-native cover", y = "Percent Cover", x = "Species") + theme_nps() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1), legend.position = "none")

# Plot of native species diversity 
spdiv <- cover %>% filter(Native == "native") %>% filter(FuncGroup %in% c("Grass", "Forb", "Shrub")) %>% filter(PctCover > 5)
spdiv$Status2 <- factor(spdiv$Status2, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn"))

ggplot(spdiv %>% dplyr::filter(Burn == "Fall24"), aes(x = SpeciesName, y = PctCover, fill = FuncGroup)) + geom_col(aes(y = mean(PctCover)),alpha = 0.8) + facet_wrap(~Status2, scales = "free_x") + scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) + labs(title = "Understory Species Diversity for Fall 2024 RX Burn", y = "Percent Cover", x = "Species Name", fill = "Functional Group") + theme_nps() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=-45,hjust=0, vjust = 1))

ggplot(spdiv %>% dplyr::filter(Burn == "Spring25"), aes(x = SpeciesName, y = PctCover, fill = FuncGroup)) + geom_col(aes(y = mean(PctCover)),alpha = 0.8) + facet_wrap(~Status2, scales = "free_x") + scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) + labs(title = "Understory Species Diversity for Spring 2025 RX Burn", y = "Percent Cover", x = "Functional Group", fill = "Functional Group") + theme_nps() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=-45,hjust=0, vjust = 1))

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

# Stats


# Stats for FuncGroup cover counts - PERMANOVA
pcover <- cover %>% group_by(Plot, Status2, Burn, FuncGroup)%>% summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = FuncGroup, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)
pcover$Status2 <- factor(pcover$Status2, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn"))

#Calculate distance matrix and run PERMANOVA
# Fall24: p = 0.323
fall24 <- pcover %>% filter(Burn == "Fall24")
cover_matrix <- as.matrix(fall24[, c("Forb", "Grass", "Shrub", "Tree")])
dist_matrix <- vegdist(cover_matrix, method = "bray")
adonis2(dist_matrix ~ Status2, data = fall24, permutations = 999)
# Spring25: p = 0.509
spring25 <- pcover %>% filter(Burn == "Spring25")
cover_matrix <- as.matrix(spring25[, c("Forb", "Grass", "Shrub", "Tree")])
dist_matrix <- vegdist(cover_matrix, method = "bray")
adonis2(dist_matrix ~ Status2, data = spring25, permutations = 999)

# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

# Shrubs
shrub <- read.csv("Biennial2026/Data/rx_shrub.csv") %>% group_by(Burn, Status2, SpeciesName, Species) %>% summarise(Hits = sum(hits), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(SpeciesName = case_when(Species == "AMAL2" ~ "Amelanchier alnifolia", Species == "ARTRV" ~ "Artemisia tridentata", 
                               Species == "DAFR6" ~ "Dasiphora fruticosa", TRUE ~ SpeciesName))
shrub$Status2 <- factor(shrub$Status2, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn"))
  
ggplot(shrub , aes(x = SpeciesName, y = Hits, fill = Status2)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(), alpha = 0.8) + facet_wrap(~Burn, scales = "free_x") + scale_fill_manual(values = nps_pal) + labs(title = "Shrub Diversity pre- and post-burn", y = "Percent Cover", x = "Shrub Species", fill = "Burn Status") + theme_nps() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=-45,hjust=0, vjust = 1)) 

#PERMANOVA for shrub species
shrubf24 <- read.csv("Biennial2026/Data/rx_shrub.csv") %>% filter(Burn == "Fall24") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = hits, values_fill = 0)
shrubs25 <- read.csv("Biennial2026/Data/rx_shrub.csv") %>% filter(Burn == "Spring25") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = hits, values_fill = 0)

# Fall24: p = 0.626
shrubf24$Status2 <- factor(shrubf24$Status2, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn"))
cover_matrix <- as.matrix(shrubf24[, c("PUTR2", "CHVIL4", "RICE", "ROWO", "OPPO")])

# Spring25: p = 0.406
```

1. Substrate Burn Severity
```{r}


library(tidyverse)
library(leaps)
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

#Load data
pred <- read.csv("tls modeling/burn_pred.csv")
vars <- read.csv("tls modeling/burn_vars.csv")

#subset to only post-burn scans
pred <- pred %>% select(-1) %>% slice(-c(1,  2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16,18, 19, 21, 22, 24,25, 27,29))
vars <- vars %>% select(-1)%>% slice(-c(1, 2, 4,6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18,19, 21, 22, 24,25,27,29))

vars <- vars %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>% select(where(~!is.factor(.) || nlevels(.) > 1)) %>% select(where(~sum(is.na(.)) == 0))

## Split data into training and test datasets
set.seed(123)
sample_size <- floor(0.2 * nrow(vars))
test_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(vars)), size = sample_size)
train_vars <- vars[-test_indices, ]
test_vars <- vars[test_indices, ]
train_pred <- pred[-test_indices, ]
test_pred <- pred[test_indices, ]

#Set method to 'seqrep', nvmax to '4' and variable to 'TreesPerAcre'
regfit = regsubsets(train_pred$SubSev~., train_vars,  nvmax = 3 , method = "seqrep", really.big = T) 

# Check models (***Question: seems to always be 4, is this step really necessary? I'm not totaly sure what I am looking for)
regsum<- summary(regfit)
plot(regsum$rsq, type = "l") 
plot(regsum$rss, type = "l") 
plot(regsum$bic, type = "l") 
which.min(regsum$bic) 
plot(regfit, scale = "r2") 

#Change # to best model
vcov(regfit,3) 
coef(regfit,2)

attach(train_vars)

# put the selected predictor variables in the model after the "~" seperated by "+" and run the model
lm1 <- lm(formula = train_pred$SubSev~ s_l2_zero_per +  vox_l1_vari +  fine_l1_std)

#look at the summary r2 values and RMSE
#***Are there specific r2 and rmse values I am looking for here??
summary(lm1)
r2(lm1)
rmse(lm1)

# Visual check of model assumptions. Make sure Linearity, homogeneity of variance, influential observations, colinearity, normality of risiduals all check out
check_model(lm1)

#use the model to predict out new values from variables alone
lm_out <- predict.lm(lm1, vars)


#format the predictions and observations for plotting
data<-data.frame(x=lm_out, y=pred$SubSev)

# Plot observed values vs. predicted
ggplot(data,aes(x,y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='lm', se=FALSE,) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(x='Predicted Values', y='Observed Values', title='?') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=20, face='bold') 
  ) 

# use the model to predict test data
test_out<- predict.lm(lm1,test_vars)

# Calculate RMSE of test data
errors<- test_out - test_pred$SubSev
mae <- mean(abs(errors))
mse <- mean(errors^2)
rmse <- sqrt(mse)
rmse

# format test predicted and observed
data2<- data.frame(x=test_out, y=test_pred$SubSev)

# Plot test observed values vs. test predicted
ggplot(data2,aes(x,y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='lm', se=FALSE,) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(x='Predicted Values', y='Observed Values', title='test') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=20, face='bold') 
  ) 


# If the model looks good, save to disk
saveRDS(lm1,  "burn/Substrate_Severity.rda") 

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#Look at how TLS modeled fuel consumption

BS <- cbind(pred, data)%>% select(c(X.1, x, y)) %>% mutate(plot = str_extract(X.1, "^[^_]+_[^_]+")) %>% 
  mutate(burn = case_when(plot %in% c("CORMP_0012", "CORMP_0014", "CORMP_0015", "CORMP_0009", "CORMP_0010", "CORMP_0008") ~ "Fall24", 
                          plot %in% c("CORMP_0051", "CORMP_0052", "CORMP_0055", "CORMP_0020") ~ "Fall25",
                          plot %in% c("CORMP_0005", "CORMP_0007", "CORMP_0001", "CORMP_0002", "CORMP_0022", "CORMP_0050")~ "Spring25"))

BS <- BS %>% select(-X.1) %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(x,y), names_to = "type", values_to = "value")


library(ggplot2)

ggplot(BS) + geom_boxplot(aes(x = burn, y = value, fill = type)) 


sum <- BS %>% group_by( burn, type ) %>% summarise(max = max(value), min = min(value), median = median(value), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value)) %>% ungroup()

ggplot(sum) + geom_col(aes(x = burn, y = mean, fill = type), position = position_dodge())+ geom_errorbar(aes(x = burn, ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean+ sd, fill = type), position = position_dodge())



```

```{r}
vars <- read.csv("tls modeling/vars2.csv")%>% select(-c(1))%>%slice(-c(9,13,16,19,22,25,32,35,38,40,43,46,49,52,55))


vars <- vars %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>% select(where(~!is.factor(.) || nlevels(.) > 1)) %>% select(where(~sum(is.na(.)) == 0))
set.seed(123)
sample_size <- floor(0.2 * nrow(vars))
test_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(vars)), size = sample_size)
train_vars <- vars[-test_indices, ]
test_vars <- vars[test_indices, ]
train_pred <- pred[-test_indices, ]
test_pred <- pred[test_indices, ]


regfit = regsubsets(train_pred$TotalAll~., train_vars,  nvmax = 3 , method = "seqrep", really.big = T) 

regsum<- summary(regfit)
plot(regsum$rsq, type = "l") 
plot(regsum$rss, type = "l") 
plot(regsum$bic, type = "l") 
which.min(regsum$bic) 
plot(regfit, scale = "r2") 

#Change # to best model
vcov(regfit,2) 
coef(regfit,2)

attach(train_vars)

# put the selected predictor variables in the model after the "~" seperated by "+" and run the model
lm1 <- lm(formula = train_pred$TotalAll~ h_l1_per +hr100_1000_l1_median)

#look at the summary r2 values and RMSE
#***Are there specific r2 and rmse values I am looking for here??
summary(lm1)
r2(lm1)
rmse(lm1)

# Visual check of model assumptions. Make sure Linearity, homogeneity of variance, influential observations, colinearity, normality of risiduals all check out
check_model(lm1)

#use the model to predict out new values from variables alone
lm_out <- predict.lm(lm1, vars)


#format the predictions and observations for plotting
data<-data.frame(x=lm_out, y=pred$TotalAll)

# Plot observed values vs. predicted
ggplot(data,aes(x,y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='lm', se=FALSE,) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(x='Predicted Values', y='Observed Values', title='?') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=20, face='bold') 
  ) 



pre_burn <- cbind(pred, data)
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

#Look at how TLS modeled fuel consumption
# first, combine pre and post
rx <- rbind(pre_burn, post_burn)%>% select(c(X, x, y))
data <- read.csv("tls modeling/pred_fuels2.csv")
rx <- full_join(rx, data) %>% mutate(plot = str_extract(X, "^[^_]+_[^_]+")) 


rx <- rx %>% slice(-c(80)) %>% mutate(burn = case_when(plot %in% c("CORMP_0012", "CORMP_0014", "CORMP_0015", "CORMP_0009", "CORMP_0010", "CORMP_0008") ~ "Fall24", plot %in% c("CORMP_0051", "CORMP_0052", "CORMP_0055", "CORMP_0020") ~ "Fall25",
                          plot %in% c("CORMP_0005", "CORMP_0007", "CORMP_0001", "CORMP_0002", "CORMP_0022", "CORMP_0050")~ "Spring25", .default = "no"))

rx <- rx %>% select(c(1:5, 18,19)) %>% filter(burn != "no")
rx <- rx %>% mutate(Status = case_when(MonStatus %in% c("00PRE", "02PR01", "02PRE", "01PRE" ,  "01YR15b", "01PR01" , "02YR15b" ,"01YR21b") ~ "PRE", 
                                       MonStatus %in% c("01POST","03POST", "02POST" ) ~ "POST", 
                                       MonStatus %in% c("01YR01") ~ "Yr01"))

rx <- rx  %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(x,y), names_to = "type", values_to = "value")


library(ggplot2)

ggplot(rx) + geom_boxplot(aes(x = Status, y = value, fill = type)) + facet_wrap(~burn)


sum <- BS %>% group_by( burn, type ) %>% summarise(max = max(value), min = min(value), median = median(value), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value)) %>% ungroup()

ggplot(sum) + geom_col(aes(x = burn, y = mean, fill = type), position = position_dodge())+ geom_errorbar(aes(x = burn, ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean+ sd, fill = type), position = position_dodge())
```
